name: 48018-longdecode-4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: 4B hybrid decoder, BF16 checkpoint: 42 layers, 21 Mamba2 / 4 attention / 17 MLP; geometry is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 2700 s safety cap, seed static 48018.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 32 prompt tokens and 1000 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0 and ignore_eos, so every sequence is the same length and none ends early. The engine tokenizes the rendered prompt, so a report may show a prompt count a few tokens either side of 32.
purpose: A compact four-billion-parameter chat assistant producing thousand-token answers from brief prompts for 256 simultaneous users on one GPU.
launch:
# How the engine is launched.

model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
trust-remote-code: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-seqs: 256
max-model-len: 1256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9

# The engine default `auto` resolves a BF16 checkpoint's SSM state to bf16, so fp32 must be
# stated explicitly to reach the declared operating point.
mamba-ssm-cache-dtype: float32

# `enforce-eager` is deliberately unset: CUDA graphs stay on for decode.
